call_points.text: The 120,000-tonne alumina silicate monolithic line, commissioned in November 2024, has enough headroom for the next couple of years.
New products developed in the last five years represent 20-25% of sales worldwide.
Raw material prices are rising because of the war; qualifying an alternate supplier takes three to nine months.
The group keeps a strong balance sheet in India so it can fund capex without bank loans.
Competitors including RHI, Krosaki and IFGL are adding Indian capacity, but management says it will not compete on price.
Exports will grow but are not a major part of the growth story because advanced refractories are bulky and uneconomic to ship.
